before: In a legacy compatibility mode, lines keep natural inter-word spaces, also with punctuation compression.
after: With punctuation compression and an East Asian default face, a line at any alignment shrinks its spaces down to half the average character width of their face to keep one more word, unless w:balanceSingleByteDoubleByteWidth is set,, and alignment compresses that line to fill the measure.
reason: Only derived layout and PDF text change. Canonical OOXML, source offsets, operations, and collaboration formats remain unchanged.
